test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

This scripture / has been /translated in / seventy languages.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **translated in.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use with "**translated**" should be "**into**" instead of "**in**."
 
• **"Translated into"** is the appropriate phrase to indicate that something has been changed from one language to another.
 
• Using **"translated in"** is incorrect as it implies the act of translation occurred within a specific language, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• The revised sentence should read: *"This scripture has been **translated into** seventy languages."*

Therefore, the correct answer is- **translated in.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: seventy languages:** This part correctly specifies the number of languages into which the scripture has been translated.
 
• **Option 2: This scripture: **This part correctly introduces the subject of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: has been: **This part is correct and sets up the passive voice construction appropriately.
